== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Blackflame Empire]] is a vast territory once ruled by [[dragons]] before being established by a family that harnessed an underground power source. The empire is currently led by [[Naru Huan|Emperor Naru Huan]], an Overlord and patriarch of the [[Naru clan]]. The [[Naru clan]] serves as the primary administrators for the empire's daily operations, acting as its public face through their reputation and emerald wings. The imperial capital is located in [[Blackflame City]], which contains numerous large central facilities and serves as the heart of the empire's administration. The empire maintains order through several mechanisms, including the [[Skysworn]], a group of wandering judges and police empowered to punish criminals. The social structure involves various major clans and servant families, such as the [[Naru]] and the [[Brightcrown|Brightcrowns]], who manage specialized sectors like medicine. The empire's defense relies on [[Underlord|Underlords]], major clans, and advanced technologies including boundary fields of [[wind]] and large [[launcher construct|launcher constructs]]. While the Emperor holds [[Authority|authority]] over vast lands, including the [[Desolate Wilds]], the empire's territorial control has faced challenges in recent generations. Additionally, a separate entity known as the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]] exists as a group of wandering conquerors who function collectively as a [[Monarch]] through a unique spiritual bond facilitated by [[Divine Treasure|Divine Treasures]].}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[The Empire]] is a powerful entity capable of executing entire clans upon detection, and it is described as possessing the largest hammer. While [[Eithan]] speaks of [[The Empire|the Empire]] with love, his own actions may have indirectly caused its total [[destruction]]. During a period of significant crisis, [[Lindon]] expresses a desire to serve the nation. Because the [[Skysworn]] refuse to place [[Lindon]]'s group in any location that could threaten [[The Empire|the Empire]], the group faces only light punishment for their absence.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[Eithan]] refers to his beloved Empire.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6">''Skysworn'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[Eithan]]'s actions may have indirectly led to the [[destruction]] of the entire Empire.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7">''Skysworn'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[Lindon]] wishes to serve [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c13">''Skysworn'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[The Empire]] will punish [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] lightly for their absence.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18">''Skysworn'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
